outcome: Premature major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events (MACCE)
cohort: Women with at least one pregnancy between 1996 and 2018, categorized into groups with migraine, GDM, both, or neither condition.
finding: Both migraine and gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) were independently associated with an increased risk of premature major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events (MACCE), with the highest risk observed in women with both conditions.
